author: you
name: BoosterRoles
short: Let server boosters make their own role, color and icon.
description: Boosters can create a custom role, change its name/color/icon via slash or prefix commands. Roles are deleted automatically when the member stops boosting or leaves.
install_msg: Run `[p]slash enablecog BoosterRoles` then `[p]slash sync` to enable slash commands. Set `[p]boosterroleset anchor <role>` so colors show.
end_user_data_statement: Stores only Discord role IDs linked to member IDs.
